    • canContinueToUse

      public boolean canContinueToUse(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Description copied from interface: MannequinGoal
      Called every tick while this goal is active, after MannequinGoal.tick(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin). Return false to signal that the goal has finished and MannequinGoal.stop(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) should be called.

      Defaults to delegating to MannequinGoal.canUse(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin) — override if the condition for continuing differs from the condition for starting (e.g. you want to keep targeting even if no new target would be selected).

      Specified by:
      canContinueToUse in interface MannequinGoal
      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin this goal is attached to
      Returns:
      true to keep running
